# Phase 5 Part 5: Toga workspaces and validated mobile transfers

This alpha includes Phase 5 Part 4, which fixes a Windows regression fixture
cleanup race by waiting for comic-library Qt workers before removing temporary
folders. All existing assertions remain required. The earlier alpha.33 submission
passed both mobile runtime and native gates (all 25 cases on Android, iPhone and
iPad, including independent iPad scenes), but its Windows cleanup error
blocked publication.

This alpha continues the selected Toga app through the mobile navigation milestones
and adds the requested managed rclone workflow. Numbered Phase 0–5 commits retain
the implementation history.

- Native Home, Files, Documents and Settings preserve independent text, Markdown,
  EPUB, comic and private sessions, recovery and Files navigation.
- Readers have compact controls, immersive reading, EPUB appearance and native
  comic zoom/pan. Wide layouts support document lists and Markdown preview.
- Ordinary iPad workspaces use independent native scenes with exclusive writers,
  separate pickers, secondary-window closure and restoration. Android supports
  adaptive layout and split-screen; independent activities remain disabled.
- Managed Local and account-scoped LocalCrypt folders offer repeatable Pull and
  reviewed Push. Local changes produce retained conflict snapshots. Push authenticates
  ciphertext, checks revisions, retains remote backups and verifies uploads.
- Progress remains visible while ordinary writing or comic reading continues.
  Empty folders are supported, OAuth refresh retains account identity, and stale
  credential reviews or externally edited records stop further operations.

Local validation passes all 25 native cases on iPhone, iPad and Android, including
actual secondary iPad scenes, Local/LocalCrypt pull/edit/push and background work.
All 67 tracked mobile host tests and the Go bridge race tests pass. Source/runtime
and native CI gates remain mandatory before this release is published. The retained
local native reports correctly identify a dirty validation snapshot; release gates
validate the clean tagged source.

Transfers run while the app is active; this does not promise OS-suspended execution.
Protected provider views are released before transfers, preserving dirty-work guards.
Push retains remote-only files and is not destructive desktop sync. Portable rclone
backends cannot promise atomic compare-and-swap against a simultaneous remote writer;
reviewed push requires avoiding concurrent external edits and may preserve completed
uploads after interruption.

Physical original-window closure and process restoration remain unverified: the beta
iPad simulator vetoed or terminated its launch scene during the optional probe.
Secondary-window creation, closure and restoration are verified. Physical provider
permissions, real fold gestures, older OS behavior, accessibility combinations and
BOOX/E Ink behavior remain device validation limits. This source alpha does not
publish an App Store or TestFlight binary. The separate PySide6 proof is preserved;
the mobile entry point remains Toga.
